name: VC:MP
author: info@wahke.lu
description:
Vice City Multiplayer is a modification for Grand Theft Auto: Vice City that allows players from around the world to join together and play Vice City in whatever style they like.

As many as 100 players can join a single server, and any player is welcome to start their own server with their own rules and gameplay. From race to deathmatch to roleplay, VC:MP lets you do it.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Pterodactyl Egg Installer Script
# Copyright (c) 2021–2025 wahke.lu
# Minimum Panel Version: 1.11.11
# Script Version: v1
# ----------------------------------------------------------
set -eu
# ========== LOG ==========
LOG="/mnt/server/install.log"
: > "$LOG"
# ========== LOG ==========
# ===== Einstellungen =====

NAME="VC:MP v39"
VERSION="v0.0.5"
YEAR="2021-2025"

TOTAL_STEPS=8   # Anzahl der Schritte +3
STEP=0

APK_BASE="curl wget ca-certificates grep sed coreutils"
REQUIRE_APK="tar xz unzip bzip2 p7zip gzip"

INSTALL="Installation abgeschlossen."
LOG2="Hinweis: volle Logs siehe $LOG"

HR="------------------------------------------------"

# ===== Einstellungen =====
# ===== Progress-Bar ======
progress_bar() {
  label="$1"
  width=34
  filled=$(( STEP * width / TOTAL_STEPS ))
  empty=$(( width - filled ))
  i=1; fill=""; while [ $i -le $filled ]; do fill="$fill#"; i=$((i+1)); done
  i=1; emp="";  while [ $i -le $empty  ]; do emp="$emp ";  i=$((i+1)); done
  percent=$(( STEP * 100 / TOTAL_STEPS ))
  printf "\r[%s%s] %3d%%  %s" "$fill" "$emp" "$percent" "$label"
}
run_step() {
  label="$1"; shift
  STEP=$((STEP+1))
  progress_bar "$label"
  sh -lc "$*" >>"$LOG" 2>&1
  progress_bar "$label ✓"
  printf "\n"
}
run_block() {
  label="$1"
  STEP=$((STEP+1))
  progress_bar "$label"
  sh -s >>"$LOG" 2>&1
  progress_bar "$label ✓"
  printf "\n"
}
# ===== Progress-Bar ======
# ==== Banner-Funktion ====
if [[ -t 1 ]] && command -v tput >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ $(tput colors) -ge 8 ]] && [[ -z "${NO_COLOR:-}" ]]; then
  BOLD="$(tput bold)"; DIM="$(tput dim)"; RESET="$(tput sgr0)"
  RED="$(tput setaf 1)"; GREEN="$(tput setaf 2)"; YELLOW="$(tput setaf 3)"
  BLUE="$(tput setaf 4)"; MAGENTA="$(tput setaf 5)"; CYAN="$(tput setaf 6)"; WHITE="$(tput setaf 7)"
else
  BOLD=""; DIM=""; RESET=""; RED=""; GREEN=""; YELLOW=""; BLUE=""; MAGENTA=""; CYAN=""; WHITE=""
fi
banner() {
  printf '%s\n' "$HR"
  printf '%b\n' "${CYAN}${BOLD}    ██     ██  █████  ██   ██ ██   ██ ███████ ${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "${CYAN}${BOLD}    ██     ██ ██   ██ ██   ██ ██  ██  ██      ${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "${CYAN}${BOLD}    ██  █  ██ ███████ ███████ █████   █████   ${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "${CYAN}${BOLD}    ██ ███ ██ ██   ██ ██   ██ ██  ██  ██      ${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "${CYAN}${BOLD}     ███ ███  ██   ██ ██   ██ ██   ██ ███████ ${RESET}"
  printf '%s\n' " "
  printf '%b\n' "${DIM}Copyright (c) ${YEAR} wahke.lu${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "Script Version : ${YELLOW}${VERSION}${RESET}"
  printf '%s\n' "$HR"
  printf '%b\n' "${BOLD}Starte ${NAME} Installation...${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "(Details: ${MAGENTA}${LOG:-/var/log/vcmp-install.log}${RESET})"
  printf '%s\n' "$HR"
  printf '%s\n' " "
}
banner
# ==== Banner-Funktion ====
# === Standard Schritte ===
run_step "Serververzeichnis leeren" \
  "mkdir -p /mnt/server && find /mnt/server -mindepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} +"
run_step "Pakete installieren" \
  "apk add --no-cache ${APK_BASE} ${REQUIRE_APK} >/dev/null"
run_step "Verzeichnisse vorbereiten" \
  "mkdir -p /mnt/server"
cd /mnt/server
# === Standard Schritte ===
# = Installation Schritte =

# 4) Server laden
run_step "VC:MP 0.4 Server herunterladen" \
  "wget -q -O VCMP04_server_v39_linux64.zip http://v04.adtec.ovh/server/VCMP04_server_v39_linux64.zip"

# 5) Server entpacken & bereinigen
run_step "Server entpacken" \
  "unzip -q VCMP04_server_v39_linux64.zip && chmod +x ./mpsvrrel64 && rm VCMP04_server_v39_linux64.zip"

# 6) server.cfg schreiben
run_step "server.cfg erstellen" \
  "cat > /mnt/server/server.cfg <<'CFG'
plugins squirrel04rel64 announce04rel64 sqlite04rel64
port 8192
maxplayers 100
servername VC:MP Another Server 
sqgamemode scripts/Main.nut

# Kern-Feature ab 0.4.7: HTTP-Downloads für Assets (optional, aber empfohlen)
# storeurl https://homepage.com/vcmp/store

# Basis-Anti-Cheat-Schalter (0 = aus, 1 = an)
anticheat 1

# ======= ANNOUNCE-PLUGIN (announce04rel64) =======
#announce <url|ip>                     # Ziel für Master-/Custom-Liste (z.B. eigener Endpunkt)
announce_verbose true                  # Ausführliches Logging des Announcers

# --- Plugin-spezifisch (nur aktiv lassen, wenn Plugin in 'plugins' mitgeladen) ---
# RCON (rcon04rel64): Remote-Konsole-Passwort
# rcon_password ChangeMe
CFG
mkdir -p /mnt/server/scripts"

# 7) Plugins laden
run_step "Plugins herunterladen" \
  "mkdir -p /mnt/server/plugins && cd /mnt/server/plugins && \
   wget -q -O allplugins.7z http://v04.adtec.ovh/allplugins_04rel006_patch2.7z"

# 8) Plugins entpacken
run_step "Plugins entpacken" \
  "cd /mnt/server/plugins && 7z x -y allplugins.7z >/dev/null && rm -f allplugins.7z"

# = Installation Schritte =

echo " "
echo "$HR"
echo "$INSTALL"
echo "$LOG2"
